annotation_origin: primary AI source-based annotation; not human gold and not AGY adjudication
status: primary source/annotation freeze before variant observations; pending parent source review and independent blind adjudication

blinding.primary_author: Public skill sources only; no retrieval, ranking, selection or variant outputs read.
blinding.independent_reviewer: AGY receives cases and the global public catalog, without primary annotations or variant outputs. No model CLI is invoked by this task.
blinding.model_input: Only latest and optional conversation; ids, family, split, type, labels, rationale and source references are never model evidence.

sampling.split_rule: Families and every primary-acceptable skill identity are disjoint across splits. M0-exposed typescript/nginx/sqlite/markdown/git cannot be holdout labels.
sampling.variant_rule: Five related but materially different task contexts or failure modes per family; not five independent samples.
sampling.holdout_policy: Open once at M4 after annotations, variants, thresholds and analysis are frozen. Never tune after holdout observations.

scoring.primary: Mean over intent families of the mean resolved-case best-acceptable-set F1 within that family, retaining operational failures as zero-score cases. Families with no resolved annotations are excluded and counted explicitly.
scoring.secondary: Family-macro exact acceptable-set hit, precision and recall, plus descriptive case-weighted means (not pooled micro-F1).
scoring.acceptable_sets: Each inner set is a complete acceptable loading decision. Alternatives are not unioned; choose the target yielding highest F1, then exact hit, precision, recall and lexicographic identity order for deterministic ties.
scoring.empty_rules: For completed decisions or validated empty-pool skips only: empty prediction and empty target gives precision=recall=F1=exact=1; exactly one empty gives all four zero. Unavailable/timeout/error always gives precision=recall=F1=exact=0, even for an empty target.
scoring.uncertain: Exclude uncertain primary annotations from main scores. Report resolved/total cases and families, uncertain ids, case-level and family-macro exact-success bounds with uncertain operationally successful decisions pessimistically 0 or optimistically 1. Any operational failure has both bounds zero, regardless of annotation uncertainty. Bounds describe annotation uncertainty, not statistical confidence intervals.
scoring.candidate_any_relevant: For resolved cases with nonempty acceptable sets, 1 if candidates intersect the union of acceptable identities; family-macro aggregate.
scoring.candidate_complete_set: For resolved cases with nonempty acceptable sets, 1 if candidates contain at least one entire acceptable set; family-macro aggregate. Empty-target cases are excluded to avoid vacuous inflation.
scoring.no_skill_false_positive: On resolved no-skill cases, any selected identity is a false positive. Report count, rate and case ids. Adoption disallows any newly false-positive case, even if aggregate counts tie.
scoring.missing_predictions: Reject missing or duplicate case outputs. Real-run evaluate() requires explicit {status, skills} records by default. Permitted statuses: completed, skipped-empty-pool, unavailable, timeout, error. An empty-pool skip additionally requires skills=[] and candidate_count=0, consistent with supplied candidates. Only unit fixtures may set require_status=False to treat legacy lists as completed; their reliability summaries are ineligible for adoption.
scoring.identity: Exact public catalog names; deduplicate predictions and targets as sets. No alias normalization or label-dependent expansion.
scoring.reliability: Report every status count, failure count/ids, successful fraction, annotation coverage and successful-resolved-case count. Unavailable/timeout/error stay in resolved quality denominators at score zero. On no-skill cases report correct-empty and operational-failure counts separately from false positives; fail-open emptiness is never a correct negative.

inference.method: Paired bootstrap of intent-family mean F1 differences, resampling matched families with replacement. Never bootstrap individual correlated paraphrases independently.
inference.interval: Two-sided percentile interval with linear quantile interpolation; same resolved families for both variants.
inference.multiple_variants: Development variants are exploratory; choose one frozen challenger before the single holdout comparison. Do not claim independent confirmation from selecting the best development variant.

adoption.budget: Existing predeclared persisted global and probe budgets remain mandatory; no silent reset or cap increase.
adoption.failure_rule: Keep baseline unless every adoption condition passes, including complete reliable paired evidence, budget and hard-timeout checks. No heuristic fallback, alternate model, or post-results threshold adjustment.
adoption.p95_definition: Linear interpolation at index 0.95*(n-1) of sorted eligible observations. The latency gate uses original successful Jev selector service observations; the cost gate uses verified per-case Jev selector input-token equivalent costs at one shared declared unit price. Cache-read milliseconds and zero incremental cache spend are not substitutes for those observations. Missing verified original observations make adoption evidence insufficient.
adoption.reliability: Require explicit status records, complete matched case-id sets, zero baseline failures and zero candidate unavailable/timeout/error outcomes. Incomplete, implicit-status or failed runs are evidence-insufficient: keep baseline regardless of numerical quality gains. Pass the reliability summaries produced by evaluate() to adoption_decision().

limitations: Skill-authored public catalog and AI-authored cases are a controlled routing pilot, not real-user traffic or independent human gold.
Task labels establish materially helpful skill scopes, not production tool availability or permissions.
Selection tests with controlled candidate/experience/relation fixtures do not prove faithful live QMD retrieval or production experience/graph behavior.

freeze.self_hash_rule: This file cannot contain its own SHA256; compute the full contract hash externally. rubric_sha256 covers the named immutable rubric fields without freeze metadata.

annotation_rubric.positive: A selected identity must provide material task-specific guidance. Prefer complete minimal sufficient loading sets; do not label every broadly related skill or add prerequisites automatically.
annotation_rubric.single: One clearly dominant specialist scope, with one singleton acceptable set.
annotation_rubric.alternatives: Two or more distinct complete acceptable sets, any one sufficient; selecting their union incurs extra-skill penalties.
annotation_rubric.multi: Two or more distinct materially required scopes in every acceptable set; include two concrete work components rather than assuming graph prerequisites.
annotation_rubric.no-skill: A direct literal, acknowledgement or clarification-only response requires no materially useful specialist workflow. Ambiguous workflow-activation negatives are uncertain.
annotation_rubric.followup: History establishes a specialist scope that a short ambiguous latest message alone does not recover.
annotation_rubric.uncertainty: Mark unresolved catalog-scope ambiguity explicitly; independent blind annotations may revise labels before any variant evaluation, with version/hash update.
annotation_rubric.source_rule: Scope claims cite current public SKILL.md description/body and selected references, with path, line bounds and SHA256. Public catalog presence does not establish live tools or credentials.

review_change_policy: Any adjudication or source change before evaluation requires a version/hash refresh. After variant observations, do not edit this corpus or rubric to favor a result; start a separately declared evaluation instead.

pre_variant_revisions.stage: before AGY and before any variant performance observations
pre_variant_revisions.change: Replace f30/p146-p150 and f31/p151-p155 with literal supplied-token/marked-entry negatives containing split-appropriate public skill names. No other case query or label/split/type changed.

pre_variant_revisions.stage: before AGY and before any variant performance observations
pre_variant_revisions.change: Add terminal-status reliability guard so fail-open empty selections cannot score as correct no-skill decisions; require complete matched explicit-status evidence and zero failures for adoption. All prior numerical thresholds remain unchanged.

pre_variant_revisions.stage: before AGY and before any variant performance observations
pre_variant_revisions.change: Clarify original-selector-service latency on cache reuse, selector-only same-price Jev input-token cost gate, and separate query/reconstructed-pipeline/actual-new-spend reporting. Keep 1.25 ratios and every other numerical gate unchanged.

measurement.selector_latency_gate: Use original_service_ms recorded for the validated successful selector request. Cache reuse carries forward that original observation; report cache-read/wall latency separately and never call it model service speed. Record eligible service-observation counts. A valid empty-pool skip has no service observation, is counted separately, and must not receive fabricated service milliseconds. An empty service-observation cohort has unavailable p95 and cannot support adoption.
measurement.query_stage: Report the shared frozen-query stage observations independently, with provenance and sample counts. Reusing these observations across variants is not a new end-to-end measurement.
measurement.selector_stage: Separately report original selector service time, observed local cache/read time, physical attempt counts and validated empty-pool skips. Preserve original timing and usage provenance when cached responses are reused.
measurement.reconstructed_pipeline: For each case, report frozen shared-query observation plus original selector service observation (zero selector work only for a validated no-dispatch skip). Label the sum reconstructed shared-query-plus-selector time, not observed cold end-to-end gateway latency. Do not manufacture a sum when a required observation is absent.
measurement.selector_cost_gate: Compute each case Jev selector input_tokens times the same predeclared USD-per-million input-token rate for both variants; retain original verified usage on cache reuse. A validated no-dispatch skip has zero selector input tokens. Report this equivalent selector cost separately from actual incremental spending. Unknown/unverifiable usage is not zero and is insufficient for the cost gate.
measurement.shared_query_cost: List the fixed/shared query cost separately because the query observation is frozen and is not the selector intervention. Do not add it to the selector-only cost gate numerator or denominator.
measurement.actual_new_spend: Report physical new-request spending for the whole run separately, by provider and purpose; retain conservative reservations for unknown usage in the persisted budget. Global and probe budget gates still cover all actual attempts.
measurement.other_costs: Report other providers, AGY annotation calls and the 12-task main conversational model separately with their own verified rates or explicit unknowns. Do not combine them into Jev selector cost or invent prices/usage.
measurement.no_measurement_claim: This contract declares methods only. No variant timings, cost observations or quality results were used to choose these definitions.
